comments.author: internal-review-repo
comments.body:
Confirmed: I own independent review and the release approval; the split in `assignment.json` @ 2766f8c8 and `brief.md` match the objective, and my recorded commitment (revision 1) gives the standard I will judge against.

What review will check, so the evidence can carry it:
- **Sampling**: exactly 1,000,000 (x, y) pairs per seed, i.i.d. uniform on [0,1), inside = x²+y² ≤ 1, estimate = 4·inside/1e6. Per-seed seed value (or SeedSequence entropy/spawn key) and inside count saved in a committed results file. Streams have to be genuinely independent. `np.random.SeedSequence(root).spawn(20)` or 20 distinct seeds into PCG64 both work; please don't reuse one generator state, and don't use consecutive seeds with a legacy generator without saying so.
- **Aggregation**: mean of the 20 estimates; t interval mean ± t(0.975,19)·s/√20 using s with ddof=1; t(0.975,19) ≈ 2.0930. Signed error = mean − math.pi and absolute error, labelled.
- **Plausibility**: per-run SD should be near √(π(4−π))/1000 ≈ 0.00164 and the half-width near 0.00077. I will recompute every summary number from the per-seed counts and re-run the code on a sample of seeds.
- **Total**: 20,000,000 points, stated.

No method concern beyond the independence point above. A figure is not needed, as the brief says. I will judge the report against the committed results files at the revisions the delivery binds.
